basic.name: Spider Mines
basic.description:
Create 3 mines that arm after 1.25 seconds. Mines detonate when an enemy comes in range, dealing 96~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 25% for 1.5 seconds.

Siege Mode: Cast range increased by 100%.

basic.name: Concussive Blast
basic.description:
Deal 141~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in front of Sgt. Hammer and knock them back.

Siege Mode: Radius increased by 50%.

basic.name: Neosteel Plating
basic.description:
Gain 25 Armor for 2 seconds.

Siege Mode: Grants 100% more Armor.

heroic.name: Napalm Strike
heroic.description: Deals 164~~0.04~~ damage on impact, and leaves a napalm area that deals 50~~0.04~~ damage per second. Lasts for 4 seconds.

heroic.name: Blunt Force Gun
heroic.description: Fire a missile across the battlefield, dealing 500~~0.03~~ damage to enemies in its path.  Deals 50% damage to Structures.

trait.name: Siege Mode
trait.description: Activate to enter Siege Mode. While in Siege Mode, Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage, have 100% increased range, and deal 25% of their damage as splash damage around the target.

mount.name: Thrusters
mount.description: Increase Movement Speed by 60% for 4 seconds. Thrusters are always active while at the Hall of Storms. Activating Thrusters cancels Siege Mode.

activable.name: Maelstrom Rounds
activable.description:
Activate to increase Basic Attack damage dealt by 40% for 5 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode reduces the cooldown of Maelstrom Rounds by 5 seconds.

Stores up to 3 charges.

level1.name: Ambush
level1.description:
Gain Stealth when entering Siege Mode or after not taking or dealing damage for 3 seconds while in Siege Mode. Basic Attacks while Stealthed deal 125% more damage.

Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

level1.name: Advanced Artillery
level1.description: Increase Siege Mode's splash damage to 60% of Basic Attack damage, and increase its splash radius by 25%.

level1.name: Maelstrom Rounds
level1.description:
Activate to increase Basic Attack damage dealt by 40% for 5 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode reduces the cooldown of Maelstrom Rounds by 5 seconds.

Stores up to 3 charges.

level4.name: Barricade
level4.description: Reduce Concussive Blast's cooldown by 4 seconds, its Mana cost by 40, and when cast create an impassable wall in front of Sgt. Hammer for 4 seconds.

level4.name: Siege Tactics
level4.description: Using Neosteel Plating while in Siege Mode grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds, as long as she remains in Siege Mode.

level4.name: Regenerative Bio-Steel
level4.description: Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

level7.name: Pulse Detonation Core
level7.description: Spider Mines detonate 3 times over 3 seconds. All damage from Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Spider Mines by 1.5 seconds. Increase this bonus to 2.5 seconds while in Siege Mode.

level7.name: Hover Siege Mode
level7.description: Sgt. Hammer can move at 50% Movement Speed while in Siege Mode.

level7.name: Graduating Range
level7.description: While in Siege Mode, Basic Attack range is increased by 1 every 1.5 seconds, up to 3.

level10.name: Blunt Force Gun
level10.description: Fire a missile across the battlefield, dealing 500~~0.03~~ damage to enemies in its path.  Deals 50% damage to Structures.

level10.name: Napalm Strike
level10.description: Deals 164~~0.04~~ damage on impact, and leaves a napalm area that deals 50~~0.04~~ damage per second. Lasts for 4 seconds.

level13.name: Tactical Mine Deployment
level13.description: Moving while Thrusters is active leaves a trail of up to 5 Spider Mines. Additionally, increase the Slow of Spider Mines by 15%.

level13.name: Entrenched
level13.description: While in Siege Mode, Concussive Blasts's damage and knockback distance are increased by 75%.

level13.name: Hyper-Cooling Engines
level13.description: While in Siege Mode, hitting Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Thrusters by 5 seconds.

level16.name: Mechanical Know-how
level16.description: Neosteel Plating grants 20% maximum Health as a Shield for 2 seconds and increases Basic Attack damage by 30% for 5 seconds.

level16.name: Executioner
level16.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

level16.name: Giant Killer
level16.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

level20.name: Orbital BFG
level20.description: Blunt Force Gun's missile orbits the planet every 5 seconds. Only the last missile fired orbits.

level20.name: Advanced Lava Strike
level20.description: Increase the cast range of Napalm Strike by 75%, and its impact deals 65% more damage.

level20.name: Shrapnel Mines
level20.description: Upon detonating, Spider Mines reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 10, up to 50, for 4 seconds.

level20.name: Ultra Capacitors
level20.description: Hitting enemy Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode grants 10% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, up to 60%.
